[[File:DX2pistol.png|250px|thumb|A DX-2 disruptor pistol]]

The '''disruptor pistol''' was similar to the [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifle]] modified into a [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] form for close combat battles. It was weaker and did less damage than a disruptor rifle, but could still vaporize whatever it hit. Primitive forms of the disruptor pistol existed as early as [[3958 BBY]], and was used by mainly criminal cartels and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] due to the fact that it was outlawed in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] because most believed it was inhumane. However, it was widely used by officers in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] army during the [[New Sith Wars]]. It was still widely used by criminal organizations by the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
